profile.headline: • Software Engineer | Web Developer •
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm Abdiel. I’ve always found genuine enjoyment in solving problems. For me, it’s like a puzzle or a challenging game that I just need to beat. As far as my software engineer skillset, I'm currently using JavaScript, ReactJS, NodeJS, SQL, and C#.

Outside of software engineering, I have a bachelor's degree in Secondary Education. I love training and presenting to large groups of people, both in-person and virtually. I have worked both as a trainer and as a 1-on-1 instructional coach. I truly enjoy working in teams and collaborating with others. I'm that person who will always try to encourage you and cheer for everyone's successes and achievements. 

Besides that, I am a tech enthusiast who loves spending time automating things. You'll know I'm a proud cat dad because I will always find an excuse to show you pictures of my beautiful cat Lynx. I love board games, especially deck builders, and anything that has to do with puzzles or strategy. I’m fascinated by AI and VR. I alternate between an Android phone and an iPhone because I love phones. I love traveling and sightseeing. 

In a world where you can be anything, be kind.

Interested in chatting? You may contact me here through LinkedIn or at gaud.abdiel@gmail.com. I look forward hearing from you!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Babycoin
A sandbox for anyone to practice trading crypto without risking real money.

• Built Achievements service front-end and back-end for the application
• Utilized Framer Motion to create a responsive design elements with Material UI like animated achievement notifications across the app
• Implemented AWS CodePipeline and CodeDeploy to streamline deployment process
positions.insights: React.js, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +10 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Chi Forum System Design API 
Comprehensive back-end API for an ecommerce web app.

• Redesigned back-end to handle 5000+ RPS, 16X the original capacity.  Maintained < 0.1% error rate and < 50ms latency when querying a database of over 20 million records
• Streamlined and sped up SQL queries with a Materialized View, increasing throughput by 300%
• Decreased stress testing cycle length by identifying and revising system bottlenecks using Loader.io, New Relic, and K6
• Enabled real-time dynamic scaling by load balancing the Dockerized service to three EC2 micro instances

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Atelier 
Ratings and reviews service for e-commerce business                            

• Architected the React front-end service of a Ratings & Reviews service backed with RESTful API backend
• Integrated monitoring of user devices with styled components and CSS media queries to allow a responsive design that optimized site design across multiple mobile, tablet and desktop devices
• Enabled sharing and reuse of functionality through  React Higher Order Components, reducing development time
